#!/usr/bin/env python3 """apps/cms-render — live HTML surface for the MDDB CMS plane. Card cmssurface-render-digest (cherry-picked Ghost features, 2026-10-14): chaba-cms had "store it" (MDDB ada-cms-pages*) but no "show it" — this is the presentation layer. No Ghost, no editor UI, no new DB: MDDB stays the store, agents stay primary authors. Reads LIVE from the CMS plane (fetch-on-request — no rebuild pipeline, no static mirror, no drift): ada-cms-pages main lane (EN default UI + content) ada-cms-pages-kk kk lane (Thai default UI + content) chaba-docs repo docs mirror (kind-less, path-shaped keys) ada-cms-automation automation registry (JSON configs -> code view) Rendered pages are cached in-memory keyed by (collection, key, lang, updatedAt) — a page re-renders only when the doc actually changed. The per-collection listing (needed for the index, slug->key resolution and lang-variant detection) refreshes on CMS_LIST_TTL_S. Routes: / index — pages grouped by nav section (meta-driven) /p/{slug-or-id} one page — kind-dispatched template; ?c= hint, ?lang=en|th variant pick (toggle when >1 lang) /k/{kind} listing of one render kind (page, report, digest, trip, place-report, timeline, media-inbox, …) /feed/{kind}.xml RSS 2.0 for that kind (newest 30) /healthz liveness + mddb reachability Page conventions followed: docs/kb/cms-page-standard.md (meta contract, thumbnail `[![a](t)](u)`, ```` ```media ```` + ```mermaid blocks) and docs/kb/media-inbox-standard.md. Internal `#/slug` links written for the CMS PWA are rewritten to `/p/slug` here. Media is LINKED (relay-img / www asset URLs pass through) — never copied. Runs on idc03 (same host as mddb-cms :11027); served publicly as cms.surf-thailand.com via the idc02 caddy edge behind Cloudflare Access — no app-level auth. Env: MDDB_CMS_URL CMS plane base (default http://127.0.0.1:11027/v1 — on idc03 mddb-cms is loopback; tailnet fallback http://100.102.134.91:11027/v1) CMS_SITE_HOST public hostname used in feed links (default cms.surf-thailand.com) CMS_LIST_TTL_S listing-cache seconds (default 120) CMS_BIND_HOST listen address (default 100.102.134.91 — idc03 tailnet IP so the idc02 edge can proxy; use 127.0.0.1 for local dev) PORT listen port (default 8010) """ from __future__ import annotations import datetime as dt import email.utils import html import json import os import re import sys import urllib.request from collections import OrderedDict from pathlib import Path import uvicorn from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, Response from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape from markdown import Markdown APP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent REPO = APP_DIR.parents[1] MDDB = os.environ.get( "MDDB_CMS_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:11027/v1").rstrip("/") SITE_HOST = os.environ.get("CMS_SITE_HOST", "cms.surf-thailand.com") LIST_TTL = float(os.environ.get("CMS_LIST_TTL_S", "120")) BIND_HOST = os.environ.get("CMS_BIND_HOST", "100.102.134.91") PORT = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8010")) VERSION = "0.1.0 2026-10-15" # Collection registry — order = /p/{slug} resolution priority + index # order. `ui` is the default UI language (kk lane reads Thai); `lang` is # the preferred content language when no ?lang= is given. COLLECTIONS = OrderedDict([ ("ada-cms-pages", {"ui": "en", "lang": "en", "label": "main"}), ("ada-cms-pages-kk", {"ui": "th", "lang": "th", "label": "kk"}), ("chaba-docs", {"ui": "en", "lang": "en", "label": "docs"}), ("ada-cms-automation", {"ui": "en", "lang": "en", "label": "auto"}), ]) EXCLUDED_STATUS = {"superseded", "archived", "retracted", "expired"} UI = { "en": { "index": "Index", "pages": "pages", "updated": "updated", "fresh": "fresh", "stale": "STALE", "language": "Language", "generated_by": "generated by", "collection": "collection", "back": "back to index", "feeds": "Feeds", "moved": "This page was superseded", "site": "chaba-cms", }, "th": { "index": "สารบัญ", "pages": "หน้า", "updated": "อัปเดต", "fresh": "สดใหม่", "stale": "เก่า", "language": "ภาษา", "generated_by": "สร้างโดย", "collection": "คอลเลกชัน", "back": "กลับไปสารบัญ", "feeds": "ฟีด", "moved": "หน้านี้ถูกย้ายแล้ว", "site": "chaba-cms", }, } # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # MDDB client def _post(path: str, payload: dict, timeout: float = 30): req = urllib.request.Request( f"{MDDB}/{path}", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}) return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout)) def get_doc(collection: str, key: str, lang: str) -> dict | None: try: d = _post("get", {"collection": collection, "key": key, "lang": lang}) except Exception: return None if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("key"): return d return None def list_docs(collection: str, limit: int = 500) -> list[dict]: """Paginated collection scan (ada-cms-pages is already >500).""" docs, offset = [], 0 while True: page = _post("search", {"collection": collection, "query": "", "limit": limit, "offset": offset}) if isinstance(page, dict): page = page.get("documents") or page.get("docs") or [] docs += page if len(page) < limit: return docs offset += limit # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # meta helpers — every meta value is a list in MDDB def meta1(meta: dict, name: str, default: str = "") -> str: v = (meta or {}).get(name) if isinstance(v, list): return str(v[0]) if v else default return str(v) if v is not None else default def truthy(v: str) -> bool: return str(v).strip().lower() in ("true", "yes", "1") def doc_slug(doc: dict) -> str: return meta1(doc.get("meta"), "slug") or doc.get("key", "") def is_stale(doc: dict, now: dt.datetime) -> bool: meta = doc.get("meta") or {} ff, upd = meta1(meta, "fresh_for"), meta1(meta, "updated") if not ff or not upd: return False try: secs = int(float(ff[:-1]) * {"h": 3600, "d": 86400, "m": 60}[ff[-1]]) when = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(upd.replace("Z", "+00:00")) return (now - when).total_seconds() > secs except Exception: return False def detect_kind(doc: dict, collection: str = "") -> str: """Render-kind dispatch — meta.kind + report_role + slug family. The family names are the per-kind templates in templates/; `page` is the catch-all.""" meta = doc.get("meta") or {} key = doc.get("key") or meta1(meta, "slug") role = meta1(meta, "report_role") domain = meta1(meta, "domain") kind = meta1(meta, "kind") if collection == "ada-cms-automation": return "automation" if collection == "chaba-docs": return "doc" if key.startswith("place-"): return "place-report" if key.startswith("trip-") or domain == "travel": return "trip" if key.startswith("house-rule") or key == "house-rules": return "house-rules" if key == "media-inbox" or key.startswith("media-"): return "media-inbox" if "timeline" in key: return "timeline" if role == "digest" or key.endswith("-digest"): return "digest" if kind == "report": return "report" return "page" # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # caches class PageCache: """Rendered HTML keyed by doc identity + updatedAt — a doc that has not changed serves the cached render; MDDB is still asked for the doc itself each request (cheap same-host /get).""" def __init__(self, maxsize: int = 512): self.maxsize = maxsize self._d: OrderedDict[tuple, tuple] = OrderedDict() def get(self, k: tuple, updated): hit = self._d.get(k) if hit and hit[0] == updated: self._d.move_to_end(k) return hit[1] return None def put(self, k: tuple, updated, value) -> None: self._d[k] = (updated, value) self._d.move_to_end(k) while len(self._d) > self.maxsize: self._d.popitem(last=False) class ListingCache: """Per-collection doc lists — slug resolution, lang variants, index. TTL rather than doc-keyed: knowing whether a listing changed requires the listing itself.""" def __init__(self, ttl: float): self.ttl = ttl self._d: dict[str, tuple[float, list[dict]]] = {} def docs(self, collection: str) -> list[dict]: ts_docs = self._d.get(collection) now = dt.datetime.now().timestamp() if ts_docs and now - ts_docs[0] < self.ttl: return ts_docs[1] docs = list_docs(collection) self._d[collection] = (now, docs) return docs def langs_of(self, collection: str, key: str) -> list[str]: return sorted({d.get("lang", "en") for d in self.docs(collection) if d.get("key") == key}) def slug_map(self, collection: str) -> dict[str, str]: out = {} for d in self.docs(collection): s = doc_slug(d) if s and s not in out: out[s] = d.get("key", s) return out def invalidate(self) -> None: self._d.clear() PAGES = PageCache() LISTING = ListingCache(LIST_TTL) # feed xml — kind -> (built_ts, xml); same TTL as the listing it derives from FEEDS: dict[str, tuple[float, str]] = {} def resolve(slug: str, coll_hint: str = "", lang: str = ""): """-> (collection, key, doc, langs) or (None,)*4. slug-or-id: try the value as a doc key first (covers chaba-docs path-keys), then the collection's meta.slug map.""" order = list(COLLECTIONS) if coll_hint in COLLECTIONS: order = [coll_hint] + [c for c in order if c != coll_hint] for coll in order: want = lang or COLLECTIONS[coll]["lang"] doc = get_doc(coll, slug, want) if doc is None and lang: doc = get_doc(coll, slug, COLLECTIONS[coll]["lang"]) if doc is None: for l in LISTING.langs_of(coll, slug): doc = get_doc(coll, slug, l) if doc: break if doc is None: key = LISTING.slug_map(coll).get(slug) if key and key != slug: doc = get_doc(coll, key, want) if doc is not None: langs = LISTING.langs_of(coll, doc["key"]) return coll, doc["key"], doc, langs return None, None, None, None # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # markdown -> html _FENCE_RE = re.compile(r"^```(mermaid|media)\s*$") _SENTINEL = "CMSRENDERBLOCK%d" def _media_block(body: str) -> str: """```media {json} -> inline video/audio player (linked, not copied).""" try: spec = json.loads(body.strip()) except Exception: spec = {} for m in re.finditer(r"(\w+)\s*[:=]\s*([^,\s}]+)", body): spec[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip('"') url = html.escape(str(spec.get("url") or spec.get("src") or "")) typ = str(spec.get("type") or "video") cap = html.escape(str(spec.get("caption") or "")) if not url: return "" tag = "audio" if typ == "audio" else "video" el = (f'<{tag} controls preload="metadata" src="{url}">' f'') return f'' def _mermaid_block(body: str) -> str: return f'
{html.escape(body)}

Handles the family blocks the page standard defines (```mermaid, ```media) and rewrites PWA `#/slug` links into render paths. Returns (html, has_mermaid).""" blocks: list[str] = [] lines, i, src = (md_text or "").splitlines(), 0, [] while i < len(lines): m = _FENCE_RE.match(lines[i].strip()) if m: j = i + 1 body_lines = [] while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip().startswith("```"): body_lines.append(lines[j]) j += 1 kind, body = m.group(1), "\n".join(body_lines) blocks.append(_mermaid_block(body) if kind == "mermaid" else _media_block(body)) src.append("") src.append(_SENTINEL % (len(blocks) - 1)) src.append("") i = j + 1 continue src.append(lines[i]) i += 1 engine = Markdown(extensions=["tables", "fenced_code", "sane_lists", "attr_list", "toc", "nl2br"]) out = engine.convert("\n".join(src)) for n, raw in enumerate(blocks): for pat in (f"

{_SENTINEL % n}

    docs = LISTING.docs(collection)
    en_keys = {d.get("key") for d in docs if d.get("lang") == "en"}
    rows, seen_keys = [], set()

        if collection == "ada-cms-automation":

                                         else domain)
        rows.append({
            "slug": slug, "key": key, "collection": collection,

            "updated_ts": d.get("updatedAt") or 0,
            "fresh": meta1(meta, "fresh_for"),
            "stale": is_stale(d, now),
            "langs": LISTING.langs_of(collection, key),

    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["updated"], r["updated_ts"]), reverse=True)

def group_rows(rows: list[dict]) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:
    groups: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for r in rows:
        groups.setdefault(r["section"], []).append(r)
    out = []
    for sec in PAGE_ORDER:
        if sec in groups:
            out.append((sec, SECTION_TITLES[sec], groups.pop(sec)))
    for sec in sorted(groups):
        out.append((sec, sec.replace("-", " ").title(), groups[sec]))
    return out

app = FastAPI(title="chaba-cms-render", version=VERSION)
env = Environment(
    loader=FileSystemLoader(str(APP_DIR / "templates")),
    autoescape=select_autoescape(["html", "xml"]))

def _render(tpl: str, **ctx) -> HTMLResponse:
    return HTMLResponse(env.get_template(tpl).render(**ctx))


def _rfc822(doc: dict) -> str:
    ts = doc.get("updatedAt") or doc.get("addedAt")
    if ts:
        return email.utils.formatdate(int(ts), usegmt=True)
    upd = meta1(doc.get("meta"), "updated")
    try:
        return email.utils.formatdate(
            dt.datetime.fromisoformat(
                upd.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp(), usegmt=True)
    except Exception:
        return ""


@app.get("/healthz")
def healthz():
    state = {"ok": True, "version": VERSION, "collections": {}}
    for coll in COLLECTIONS:
        try:
            docs = LISTING.docs(coll)
            state["collections"][coll] = len(docs)
        except Exception as e:
            state["collections"][coll] = f"ERR {type(e).__name__}"
            state["ok"] = False
    return JSONResponse(state)


@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def index():
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    sections = []
    for coll in COLLECTIONS:
        first = True
        for sec, title, srows in group_rows(index_rows(coll, now)):
            shown = srows[:40]
            sections.append({
                "id": f"{sec}-{coll}", "title": title,
                "collection": coll, "ui": COLLECTIONS[coll]["ui"],
                "coll_first": first,
                "count": len(srows), "rows": shown,
                "more": len(srows) - len(shown)})
            first = False
    return _render("index.html", sections=sections, ui=UI["en"],
                   host=SITE_HOST, title="chaba-cms index")


@app.get("/k/{kind}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def kind_listing(kind: str, c: str = Query(default="")):
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    colls = [c] if c in COLLECTIONS else list(COLLECTIONS)
    rows = []
    for coll in colls:
        rows += [r for r in index_rows(coll, now) if r["kind"] == kind]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["updated"], r["updated_ts"]), reverse=True)
    return _render("listing.html", kind=kind, rows=rows[:200],
                   count=len(rows), ui=UI["en"], title=f"{kind} — chaba-cms")


@app.get("/feed/{kind}.xml")
def feed(kind: str):
    now_ts = dt.datetime.now().timestamp()
    hit = FEEDS.get(kind)
    if hit and now_ts - hit[0] < LIST_TTL:
        return Response(hit[1], media_type="application/rss+xml")
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    items = []
    for coll in ("ada-cms-pages", "ada-cms-pages-kk"):
        for r in index_rows(coll, now):
            if r["kind"] == kind:
                items.append((r, coll))
    items = items[:30]
    xml_items = []
    for r, coll in items:
        doc = get_doc(coll, r["key"], COLLECTIONS[coll]["lang"])
        link = (f"https://{SITE_HOST}/p/{r['slug']}"
                + (f"?c={coll}" if coll != "ada-cms-pages" else ""))
        xml_items.append({
            "title": r["title"], "link": link, "guid": f"{coll}/{r['key']}",
            "description": r["summary"] or r["title"],
            "pubDate": _rfc822(doc or {"meta": {"updated": [r["updated"]]}}),
        })
    xml = env.get_template("feed.xml").render(
        kind=kind, title=f"chaba-cms — {kind}", host=SITE_HOST,
        items=xml_items)
    FEEDS[kind] = (now_ts, xml)
    return Response(xml, media_type="application/rss+xml")


@app.get("/p/{slug:path}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def page(slug: str, c: str = Query(default=""), lang: str = Query(default="")):
    slug = slug.strip("/")
    coll, key, doc, langs = resolve(slug, coll_hint=c, lang=lang)
    if doc is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, f"no doc for {slug!r}")
    updated = doc.get("updatedAt") or meta1(doc.get("meta"), "updated")
    ck = (coll, key, doc.get("lang"), lang)
    hit = PAGES.get(ck, updated)
    if hit is not None:
        return HTMLResponse(hit)

    meta = doc.get("meta") or {}
    ui_lang = COLLECTIONS[coll]["ui"]
    ui = UI.get(ui_lang, UI["en"])
    kind = detect_kind(doc, coll)
    fmt = meta1(meta, "format")
    if fmt == "json" or kind == "automation":
        try:
            body = json.dumps(json.loads(doc.get("contentMd") or "{}"),
                              indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        except Exception:
            body = doc.get("contentMd") or ""
        content = f"
{html.escape(body)}
"
        has_mermaid = False
    else:
        content, has_mermaid = md_to_html(doc.get("contentMd") or "", coll)
    moved = meta1(meta, "moved_to") or meta1(meta, "superseded_by")
    slug_out = doc_slug(doc)
    ctx = dict(
        ui=ui, ui_lang=ui_lang, title=meta1(meta, "title") or key,
        content=content, kind=kind, collection=coll, slug=slug_out,
        updated=meta1(meta, "updated")[:16], fresh=meta1(meta, "fresh_for"),
        stale=is_stale(doc, dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)),
        status=meta1(meta, "status") or "active",
        role=meta1(meta, "report_role"), domain=meta1(meta, "domain"),
        generated_by=meta1(meta, "generated_by") or meta1(meta, "written_by"),
        summary=meta1(meta, "summary"), moved=moved, langs=langs,
        cur_lang=doc.get("lang", "en"), has_mermaid=has_mermaid,
        host=SITE_HOST, version=VERSION)
    tpl = f"{kind}.html"
    try:
        env.get_template(tpl)
    except Exception:
        tpl = "page.html"
    html_out = env.get_template(tpl).render(**ctx)
    PAGES.put(ck, updated, html_out)
    return HTMLResponse(html_out)


def main() -> None:
    uvicorn.run(app, host=BIND_HOST, port=PORT, log_level="info")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
